_info: English names for prompts to the language models (KI-Variante). Interface text is translated elsewhere.

lagerfeuer.name: Campfire
lagerfeuer.desc: Heart of the settlement for storing, eating and warmth. Researchers think here until there is a writing room.

huette.name: Hut
huette.desc: Home for 2 settlers. More homes mean more children.

holzhaus.name: Wooden house
holzhaus.desc: A solid plank house for 4 settlers. People living here have children 40% more often. Huts can be upgraded to it.

steinhaus.name: Stone house
steinhaus.desc: A large house with a tile roof for 6 settlers. People living here have children 80% more often.

lager.name: Storehouse
lager.desc: Storage space 400 for supplies. Big goods like planks need more space than small ones like berries. Also another drop-off point.

grosslager.name: Large store
grosslager.desc: A stone storehouse with storage space 1000 for all goods.

feld.name: Grain field
feld.desc: A farmer sows and harvests grain here.

obstgarten.name: Orchard
obstgarten.desc: Apple trees tended by a farmer. Grows slower than grain but gives a lot of fruit.

muehle.name: Windmill
muehle.desc: Grinds grain into flour for the bakery.

baeckerei.name: Bakery
baeckerei.desc: Bakes bread from flour, which keeps you full for a long time.

raeucherei.name: Smokehouse
raeucherei.desc: Smokes fish so it keeps you full much longer.

huehnerhof.name: Chicken farm
huehnerhof.desc: Chickens are fed grain and lay eggs.

lehmgrube.name: Clay pit
lehmgrube.desc: A stonecutter digs clay here for bricks.

ziegelei.name: Brickworks
ziegelei.desc: Fires clay in a kiln into hard bricks.

steinbruch.name: Quarry
steinbruch.desc: Gives endless stone, even when the island's rocks are used up.

koehlerei.name: Charcoal kiln
koehlerei.desc: A kiln turns wood into hot charcoal.

mine.name: Ore mine
mine.desc: A tunnel into the rock. Gives ore and some stone.

schmelze.name: Smelter
schmelze.desc: Melts ore with coal into iron.

schmiede.name: Smithy
schmiede.desc: Makes good tools from iron and planks.

schreibstube.name: Writing room
schreibstube.desc: Two researchers work twice as fast here as at the campfire. Can be upgraded in three costly steps.

schreibstube2.name: Large writing room
schreibstube2.desc: Writing room level 2: three researchers, 40% faster than level 1.

schreibstube3.name: Scholars' room
schreibstube3.desc: Writing room level 3: three researchers, almost twice as fast as level 1.

schreibstube4.name: Academy
schreibstube4.desc: Writing room level 4: four researchers work more than two and a half times as fast as level 1.

bibliothek.name: Library
bibliothek.desc: House of knowledge: three researchers work almost twice as fast as in the writing room.

werft.name: Shipyard
werft.desc: Craftsmen build ships on the shore. You choose which ship is built next. Has a berth for one rowboat.

anlegesteg.name: Jetty
anlegesteg.desc: A wooden pier: 2 berths for rowboats, loading is faster than on the beach.

hafen.name: Harbor
hafen.desc: Quay wall with crane: 2 berths for cogs and fast sailers, fast loading. Medium ships need a harbor to visit the island.

grosser_hafen.name: Large harbor
grosser_hafen.desc: Deep basin and two cranes: 3 berths, also for galleons. Very fast loading.

holzkai.name: Wood quay
holzkai.desc: Quay for wood, planks and coal: these goods load three times as fast. 1 berth for medium ships.

steinkai.name: Ore quay
steinkai.desc: Quay for stone, clay, bricks, ore, iron, gold and tools: three times as fast loading. 1 berth for medium ships.

proviantkai.name: Food quay
proviantkai.desc: Quay with a cold cellar for all food: three times as fast loading. 1 berth for medium ships.

wachturm.name: Watchtower
wachturm.desc: An archer keeps watch and shoots wild animals nearby. Settlers flee here when in danger.

leuchtturm.name: Lighthouse
leuchtturm.desc: Its fire guides the boats: exploring takes half as long and all boats go faster.

denkmal.name: Monument
denkmal.desc: A golden monument to the founders. On all islands more children are born and everyone lives 6 days longer.

schule.name: School
schule.desc: Children learn to read and count here. Up to 8 pupils grow up twice as fast.

glashuette.name: Glassworks
glashuette.desc: A hot furnace makes glass from clay and coal.

papiermuehle.name: Paper mill
papiermuehle.desc: A water wheel pounds wood into pulp to make paper.

universitaet.name: University
universitaet.desc: Scholars of all fields: four researchers work three and a half times as fast as in the writing room.

stahlwerk.name: Steelworks
stahlwerk.desc: A blast furnace makes hard steel from iron and a lot of coal.

fabrik.name: Factory
fabrik.desc: Steam machines build new machines from steel and wood.

konservenfabrik.name: Cannery
konservenfabrik.desc: Fish in tin cans: very filling and never spoils.

mietshaus.name: Apartment house
mietshaus.desc: Three floors of brick for 10 settlers. People living here have children 20% more often.

kraftwerk.name: Power plant
kraftwerk.desc: Burns coal to make power for factories, labs and computers.

gewaechshaus.name: Greenhouse
gewaechshaus.desc: Apples grow under glass all year, even in winter.

wohnblock.name: Apartment block
wohnblock.desc: A tall building of concrete and glass for 16 settlers. People living here have children 40% more often.

elektronikwerk.name: Electronics plant
elektronikwerk.desc: Chips are made from glass, steel and power in a clean room.

solarpark.name: Solar park
solarpark.desc: Turns sunlight into power without coal. A craftsman keeps the panels clean.

labor.name: Research lab
labor.desc: Microscopes, computers and antennas: four researchers work six times as fast as in the writing room.

ki_zentrum.name: AI center
ki_zentrum.desc: An AI helps with research: four researchers ten times as fast as in the writing room. It gives idle settlers the jobs that are missing, and everyone works 20% faster.

fusionsreaktor.name: Fusion reactor
fusionsreaktor.desc: A small sun in a hall: a lot of power without coal.

zukunftsstadt.name: Future city
zukunftsstadt.desc: Glass towers, green roofs and a rocket: the goal of all ages. On all islands children come twice as often, everyone lives 20 days longer and works 30% faster.

steinwerkzeuge.name: Stone tools
steinwerkzeuge.desc: Sharp stone blades: cutting wood and stone is 25% faster.

flechtkoerbe.name: Woven baskets
flechtkoerbe.desc: Settlers carry 2 more items at once.

schrift.name: Writing
schrift.desc: Knowledge can be written down. Unlocks the writing room.

gartenbau.name: Gardening
gartenbau.desc: Unlocks the orchard. Fields give 20% more.

holzbearbeitung.name: Woodworking
holzbearbeitung.desc: Unlocks the saw pit. Wood becomes planks.

zimmerei.name: Carpentry
zimmerei.desc: Unlocks the wooden house for 4 settlers. Huts can be upgraded. Building is 20% faster.

toepferei.name: Pottery
toepferei.desc: Unlocks the clay pit and brickworks.

muehlenbau.name: Mill building
muehlenbau.desc: Unlocks the windmill, which grinds grain into flour.

raeuchern.name: Smoking
raeuchern.desc: Unlocks the smokehouse. Fishers catch 25% faster.

steinbruch.name: Quarry
steinbruch.desc: Unlocks the quarry, which gives endless stone.

vorratshaltung.name: Storage
vorratshaltung.desc: Better shelves and barrels: all stores hold 25% more.

maurerei.name: Masonry
maurerei.desc: Unlocks the stone house (6 settlers) and the large store.

backkunst.name: Baking
backkunst.desc: Unlocks the bakery. Bread keeps you full for long.

tierhaltung.name: Animal keeping
tierhaltung.desc: Unlocks the chicken farm, which turns grain into eggs.

bewaesserung.name: Irrigation
bewaesserung.desc: Ditches and jugs: fields and orchards grow 30% faster.

koehlerei.name: Charcoal kiln
koehlerei.desc: Unlocks the charcoal kiln, which gives charcoal for metal.

heilkunde.name: Healing
heilkunde.desc: Herbs and care: settlers live 8 days longer and get well twice as fast.

unterricht.name: Teaching
unterricht.desc: Reading, writing, counting: unlocks the school, where children grow up twice as fast.

handkarren.name: Handcarts
handkarren.desc: Settlers carry 3 more items and walk 15% faster.

gelehrsamkeit.name: Scholarship
gelehrsamkeit.desc: Unlocks the library. All researchers work 20% faster.

eisenverhuettung.name: Iron smelting
eisenverhuettung.desc: Unlocks the smelter, which makes iron from ore and coal.

schmiedekunst.name: Smithing
schmiedekunst.desc: Unlocks the smithy, which makes tools.

eisenwerkzeuge.name: Iron tools
eisenwerkzeuge.desc: Iron axes, hoes and sickles: all work is 30% faster.

eisenpflug.name: Iron plow
eisenpflug.desc: Deeper plowing: fields and orchards give 50% more.

baumeisterkunst.name: Building skill
baumeisterkunst.desc: Cranes and pulleys: building is 40% faster.

schiffsbau.name: Shipbuilding
schiffsbau.desc: Unlocks the shipyard, the jetty and the sailor job. Rowboats explore the sea and carry settlers and goods to other islands.

waffenkunde.name: Weapons
waffenkunde.desc: Spears and bows: unlocks the watchtower and the hunter job. Settlers fight wild animals twice as well.

navigation.name: Navigation
navigation.desc: Compass and star maps: ships go 50% faster and take 2 more settlers. Unlocks the harbor and the cog.

seehandel.name: Sea trade
seehandel.desc: Large harbors, quays for certain goods, galleons and fast sailers.

jagdkunst.name: Hunting skill
jagdkunst.desc: Traps and tracking: hunters hit 50% harder and killed animals give more meat.

befestigung.name: Fortification
befestigung.desc: Stone walls: watchtowers shoot farther and 60% harder.

pelzkleidung.name: Warm clothes
pelzkleidung.desc: Fur coats and blankets: settlers get hungry 15% slower and live 4 days longer.

leuchtfeuer.name: Beacon
leuchtfeuer.desc: Unlocks the lighthouse, which guides boats safely and faster across the sea.

goldenes_zeitalter.name: Golden Age
goldenes_zeitalter.desc: The crown of your culture. Unlocks the monument, which brings more children and longer life on all islands.

glasmacherei.name: Glassmaking
glasmacherei.desc: Unlocks the glassworks: clay and coal become glass.

papier.name: Paper
papier.desc: Unlocks the paper mill: wood becomes paper.

uhrwerk.name: Mechanical clock
uhrwerk.desc: Fixed work hours: everyone works 10% faster.

astronomie.name: Astronomy
astronomie.desc: Telescope and star maps: ships go 30% faster, exploring is 30% faster.

buchdruck.name: Printing
buchdruck.desc: Movable type: knowledge spreads, research is 25% faster.

hochschule.name: University
hochschule.desc: Unlocks the university, where four researchers work very fast.

fruchtwechsel.name: Crop rotation
fruchtwechsel.desc: Fields change crops and recover: 40% more harvest.

anatomie.name: Anatomy
anatomie.desc: Doctors understand the body: the sick heal faster, everyone lives 6 days longer.

dampfmaschine.name: Steam engine
dampfmaschine.desc: Steam drives saws and pumps: wood, stone and ore are 30% faster.

stahl.name: Steel
stahl.desc: Unlocks the steelworks: iron and coal become steel.

konservendose.name: Tin can
konservendose.desc: Unlocks the cannery: canned fish never spoils.

fabrik.name: Factories
fabrik.desc: Unlocks the factory, which builds machines. All workshops work 20% faster.

eisenbahn.name: Railway
eisenbahn.desc: Rails and carts: settlers walk 30% faster and carry 4 more items.

mietshaus.name: Apartment houses
mietshaus.desc: Unlocks the apartment house for 10 settlers.

elektrizitaet.name: Electricity
elektrizitaet.desc: Unlocks the power plant. Electric light: everyone works 10% faster.

telegraf.name: Telegraph
telegraf.desc: Messages in seconds: exploring is 50% faster, research 20% faster.

impfung.name: Vaccines
impfung.desc: Vaccines protect: the sick heal twice as fast, everyone lives 8 days longer.

kuehltechnik.name: Refrigeration
kuehltechnik.desc: Fridges: fresh food spoils much slower.

verbrennungsmotor.name: Combustion engine
verbrennungsmotor.desc: Trucks and tractors: building is 50% faster, fields ripen 40% faster.

wohnblock.name: Apartment blocks
wohnblock.desc: Unlocks the apartment block for 16 settlers.

gewaechshaus.name: Greenhouse
gewaechshaus.desc: Unlocks the greenhouse, where apples grow all year.

motorschiffe.name: Motor ships
motorschiffe.desc: Ship engines: all ships go 50% faster.

computer.name: Computers
computer.desc: Unlocks the electronics plant. Computers help research: 30% faster.

solarenergie.name: Solar power
solarenergie.desc: Unlocks the solar park: power from sunlight, without coal.

automatisierung.name: Automation
automatisierung.desc: Controlled machines: workshops work 40% faster, wood and stone are 30% faster.

internet.name: Internet
internet.desc: All knowledge linked: research 50% faster. Unlocks the research lab.

logistik.name: Logistics
logistik.desc: Computer storage: 50% more storage, settlers carry 4 more items and walk 20% faster.

gentechnik.name: Genetic engineering
gentechnik.desc: Strong plants and new medicine: fields give 50% more, everyone lives 10 days longer.

ki.name: Artificial intelligence
ki.desc: Unlocks the AI center: it helps research and gives idle settlers the jobs that are missing.

fusionsenergie.name: Nuclear fusion
fusionsenergie.desc: Unlocks the fusion reactor: a lot of power without coal.

robotik.name: Robotics
robotik.desc: Robots help everywhere: everyone works 30% faster, building is 50% faster.

zukunftsstadt.name: Future city
zukunftsstadt.desc: The goal of all ages: unlocks the future city.

steinmetz.name: Stonecutter
steinmetz.desc: Cuts stone, ore and gold from rocks; works in the quarry, clay pit and mine.

fischer.name: Fisher
fischer.desc: Fishes at fishing spots on the shore.

koch.name: Cook
koch.desc: Works in the mill, bakery, smokehouse and chicken farm.

handwerker.name: Craftsman
handwerker.desc: Works in the saw pit, brickworks, charcoal kiln, smelter, smithy and shipyard.

forscher.name: Researcher
forscher.desc: Does research at the campfire or in the writing room and library.

jaeger.name: Hunter
jaeger.desc: Hunts wild animals, brings meat and furs and clears animal dens.

seemann.name: Sailor
seemann.desc: Sails as crew on the ships. No ship leaves without sailors. On land he fishes.

nahrung.name: Secure food
nahrung.desc: More gatherers, fishers, farmers and cooks; new fields.

winter.name: Stock up for winter
winter.desc: Lots of firewood, food that keeps (smokehouse, bakery), full stores.

wachstum.name: Grow
wachstum.desc: New and better houses, a school, enough food for children.

bauen.name: Building and workshops
bauen.desc: Workshops and production chains, more wood and stone.

wissen.name: Knowledge and research
wissen.desc: More researchers, writing room, library and school.

sicherheit.name: Protection from animals
sicherheit.desc: Hunters and watchtowers against wild animals.

seefahrt.name: Seafaring and trade
seefahrt.desc: Shipyard, harbors and ships, find new islands.
